name: 46711 · Berne, IN
findings: ZIP 46711 (Berne) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46711 (Berne) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
64% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46711 (Berne) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
